author: Myv
body:
Hello, Sk33nDhu and myself are proud to present out first CTW and joint map, Iquora, for the CTW contest and for potential testing.

Map Information

Team Sizes: 20v20
Team Colours: Purple and Yellow
Server Hosted: alexanderjoe
Wools: 2 per side, Cyan and Orange, Red and Green
No diamonds.

Techy Stuff

Download: Will be done if needed 
XML: Will be done if needed also (require MapDev)

Please feel free to leave feedback below, we really spent a long time on this and we would appreciate constructive criticism/praise.

Album: http://imgur.com/a/Lg0Cw

Regards,
Myv and Sk33nDhu
